notes.subject: סלסלה
notes.rationale: Piel reduplication of סלל, to mound up/exalt — intensively 'exalt her', the doubled consonants mimic lifting

notes.subject: givim nem gutpela long yu
notes.rationale: תכבדך literally 'she will make you heavy' i.e. honor; Tok Pisin idiom of good name used

translation: Salim ██ i antap, na ⟨em⟩ bai kirapim yu; ⟨em⟩ bai givim nem gutpela long yu, sapos yu skruim ⟨em⟩ wantaim brata.

tokens.gloss: em bai givim nem gutpela long yu
